capability: Check what must stay true on every wiki edit
title: A wiki with pins.

hook.picture: Close on the whale (z 1.6) following a thin thread from one dot on the line to the next. The thread ends in empty air and the whale bumps into nothing.
hook.words: I followed the link. It went nowhere.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I followed the wiki's link, and it went nowhere.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Ghost lines of past edits stack behind the line. Each edit is saved at once and each snaps a different thread: every 2 beats, then 1, then half.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Edits get saved. No one checks the rest.

stakes.body: New people and AI helpers read the wiki as true. One broken link sends both to a dead page, and the wrong answer travels.

solution_hint: Name what must stay true. Check every edit.

metaphor.body: The wiki is a line with dots joined by threads. Three pins hold what must stay true, so the line can bend freely and the threads still land.

steps.picture: Three pins drop into the hollow dots. The line passes through each one. Two pins carry icons: a single page and a source tick.
A chip appears on the first pin.
Free edits: the whale bends the line hard three times. It still runs through all three pins, and a ring flashes on each edit.
steps.words: Edit freely. These three laws never move.

steps.picture: Push-in (z 1.28). An edit tugs the link pin, a copper offset shows the break, a gate before save closes, and the whale pulls the line back to the pin. The gate glows open.
steps.words: Breaks a link? Stopped and fixed before saving.
steps.sound: Tap goes flat, then snaps into tune.

steps.picture: One tick lands on the strip under the line.

real_case.claim: Merging the 437-entity p5.js atlas with 111 new lab entities gave 548 entities and 2,933 triples with exact violations 0 and provenance coverage 0.988.

honest_limit.picture: One sourced dot's source tick opens into a grid of 60 ticks: 47 teal, 13 copper. The citation audit fails 13, but the pins never noticed.
honest_limit.words: A source can still say something else.

not_this.body: Checked means no known breaks. Not true.

ending_pattern.body: The new-hire whale follows the same thread from the same dot and lands on a pinned dot. The pod that answered with a cross now answers with a tick.
ending_pattern.callback: The thread that ended in empty air in bar 1 now lands on a pin, in the same framing.

end_belief.body: Pick three things your wiki must keep.

beats.picture: Close on the whale (z 1.6) following a thin thread from one dot on the line to the next. The thread ends in empty air and the whale bumps into nothing.
The whale hangs at the loose thread end, looking around.
beats.words: I followed the link. It went nowhere.

beats.picture: The loose thread flutters. The whale's spout droops.
A pod swims in, reads the same dot and answers with a copper cross chip.
The pod's cross chip pulses once.
beats.words: The AI answered from that broken page.

beats.picture: The whale looks back along the line: two more loose threads flutter behind it. Hold.
Half a bar of stillness, then SERIES.open title.
Pull back (z 1.6 to 1.0): a long line with ghost lines of past edits stacked behind it.
Three-times device: an edit lands and is saved, a thread snaps. Every 2 beats.
beats.words: Edits get saved. No one checks the rest.

beats.picture: Two more edits, every 1 beat then every half beat, each snapping a different thread.
All motion stops. Three hollow dots glow softly where the threads should land.
beats.words: Name what must stay true. Check every edit.
beats.sound: One clean in-tune tap: first signature.

beats.picture: Three pins drop into the hollow dots. The line passes through each one. Two pins carry icons: a single page and a source tick.
A chip appears on the first pin.
Free edits: the whale bends the line hard three times. It still runs through all three pins, and a ring flashes on each edit.
beats.words: Edit freely. These three laws never move.

beats.picture: Push-in (z 1.28). An edit tugs the link pin, a copper offset shows the break, a gate before save closes, and the whale pulls the line back to the pin. The gate glows open.
beats.words: Breaks a link? Stopped and fixed before saving.
beats.sound: Tap goes flat, then snaps into tune.

beats.picture: One tick lands on the strip under the line.
Wide. Two lines, chips 437 and 111, slide together and merge into one long line. The three pins hold through the merge and ticks stream on the strip.
beats.words: Real run: our own two wikis, merged.

beats.picture: Card fades in on clean paper: Real run · Memory graph map.
Slow drift along the merged line: each new dot carries a small source tick and the strip ticks once per dot.
beats.words: Every new link came with its source.

beats.picture: Still, then a slow push into one sourced dot. Its source tick opens into a grid of 60 small ticks: 47 turn teal, 13 turn copper. All three pins stay lit.
beats.words: A source can still say something else.

beats.picture: Pull back to the line, pins still lit.
beats.words: Checked means no known breaks. Not true.

beats.picture: FELT framing restored (z 1.6). The new-hire whale follows the same thread from the same dot, and this time it lands on a pinned dot.
beats.camera: FELT framing z 1.6, then wide reveal

beats.picture: A counter chip sits by the link pin.
beats.camera: FELT framing z 1.6, then wide reveal

beats.picture: The pod from bar 3 swims back, reads the dot and answers with a teal tick chip. The whale spouts: delight, spark.
beats.camera: FELT framing z 1.6, then wide reveal

beats.picture: Still line, three pins, the whale breathing.
beats.words: Pick three things your wiki must keep.

beats.picture: SERIES.lockup over the settled line.
beats.sound: Pad tail ends on the tonic.
